sourceInformation.source: Tenchu 2: Birth of the Stealth Assassins (Acquire, PlayStation, 2000)
sourceInformation.perspective: Isometric third person (engine iso view), rotatable 45 degrees
sourceInformation.tech: my-3D2dge v0.85.2 engine (handoff build, unpatched), vanilla JavaScript in one HTML file; Node build script; Python Playwright tests
sourceInformation.artDirection: Engine pixel-art style with procedural shapes and materials; no image files
sourceInformation.animation: Engine procedural Humanoid rig, E.Attack and takedown action
sourceInformation.audio: Engine chip synth; layered music in code. Voices not in this build
sourceInformation.testing: Scripted browser checks in headless Chromium from file://; no AI Hub harness
sourceInformation.research: Public description of the source and the engine's stealth kit
sourceInformation.environment: Claude Code CLI (headless); Linux (WSL2); headless Chromium via Playwright

testingFeedback: 3 problems in the test setup (a page crash with default browser flags, a wrong scene probe, a loose Silent Cut check); 0 game bugs found by the checks.
0 found by the checks. The checks cover boot, attract, mission start, a Silent Cut, the Ki readout, the objective, Dev Mode values and the touch-only notice; they do not cover a full playthrough.
A real Silent Cut from behind, checking the kill count and the guard's state.
The attract timing check, which waits real seconds and says little about the game.
engineFeedback: The stealth kit: E.sees, E.Suspicion, E.FlowField, takedown actions and the Shell HUD made the core loop cheap to build.
The scene name is on game.sceneName, not game.scene. I was unsure of the Shell's back and current-screen calls, so I avoided them.
Shadow Sight, the Ki gauge, the Dev Mode sliders, the attract autopilot, the title and the About screens. The engine has none of these.
The size of the API: about 1.2 MB, and a long card. Finding the right call took many searches.
None. engine.js is the handoff build, unpatched.
Name the current scene consistently across game and tests, and add a current-screen query on the Shell.
promptFeedback: The stage file was clear about where deliverables go, and the testing rules (one command, failures only) were concrete.

The plan is about 1,900 lines and assumes a team and weeks, while the goal asks for every feature. It also uses other model names and a different timestamp in its file names; TASK.md wins, as the stage file says.
Fitting the plan's scope into one session. I cut it to a vertical slice and say so.
Mark which features are required for a demo and which are stretch, and state the scope the goal expects.

aiHub.name: Bentou 2: Birth of the Lunchbox Assassins
aiHub.tagline: Seen by none. Fed by all.
aiHub.description: A one-mission isometric ninja stealth slice: slip past lantern-lit guards, land Silent Cuts from behind and above, steal the ledger and get out by the east gate.
aiHub.source: Tenchu 2: Birth of the Stealth Assassins
